opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200, up to £500, up to £750, up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva (Scheme A), or PhD students and postdocs within six years for Schemes B & C; applicants must be UK‑based or UK‑based for overseas conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientists at conferences (Genetics Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) with travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or you intend to carry out your fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 (usually below £1,700) to cover travel and accommodation costs for field‑based genetic research projects whose results are suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs.
